items.text: Free AI courses for engineering and high school students are worth using when they lead to a small working project, so choose one beginner programming track, one machine learning basics course and one project, and treat every certificate as secondary to what you can demonstrate.
Start with Python and basic statistics, add one machine learning course and publish one small project with a written explanation of what it does and where it fails.
